organization.description: Digital ID and Authentication Council of Canada (DIACC). Canadian non-profit coalition of public and private sector organizations focused on advancing digital trust, digital identity, authentication, and verification. DIACC develops and maintains the Pan-Canadian Trust Framework (PCTF) and promotes interoperable, privacy-enhancing digital trust ecosystems.
